# TravelSync AI

> LINE bot that helps groups plan trips together. Free text in groups is parsed into structured trip items; slash commands handle ops; a per-trip orchestrator (Gemini tool-use loop) proposes/applies updates across the trip's bento grids.

## Architecture invariants — read first

- Single inbound endpoint: [app/api/line/webhook/route.ts](app/api/line/webhook/route.ts)
- Single dispatcher: [services/event-processor.ts](services/event-processor.ts)
- Single outbound chokepoint: [lib/line.ts](lib/line.ts) — never call `@line/bot-sdk` directly outside this file
- Durable queue = `line_events` table; no external queue lib
- Per-trip orchestrator: [services/orchestrator/runner.ts](services/orchestrator/runner.ts), tools in [services/orchestrator/tools.ts](services/orchestrator/tools.ts)

## Docs

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): operational guidance for AI agents working in this repo

## Conventions

- Zod-first APIs: every route validates body + query with Zod at the top of the handler
- Path alias: `@/*` → repo root
- Tests in [__tests__/](__tests__/) (unit, integration, flows, api); evals in [__tests__/evals/](__tests__/evals/)
- shadcn/ui + Tailwind only; no custom CSS files
- LLM telemetry: every Gemini/Anthropic call is recorded in `llm_calls`; see [lib/llm.ts](lib/llm.ts)
- Prompts live in [prompts/](prompts/), versioned with content hashes
- Migrations in [supabase/migrations/](supabase/migrations/); regenerate `lib/database.types.ts` after each one

## How to make changes

- Slash commands for Claude Code in [.claude/commands/](.claude/commands/): `/new-tool`, `/new-agent`, `/new-migration`, `/replay-orchestrator-run`
- Subagents in [.claude/agents/](.claude/agents/): `orchestrator-tool-writer`, `prompt-evaluator`, `migration-author`
